workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Volcengine Ark AccountOverdueError is retried when the HTTP status is missing
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agent-runtime): treat Volcengine AccountOverdueError wording as terminal. Target files: packages/agent-runtime/src/agent-errors.test.ts, packages/agent-runtime/src/agent-errors.ts, docs/spec/03-runtime/02-agent-runtime.md. `classifyAgentError` now treats Volcengine Ark's `AccountOverdueError` code and `overdue balance` / `account has an overdue` wording as terminal billing exhaustion. A statusless body or a gateway 429 no longer spends the retry budget. (Ref: https://github.com/vastsa/PI-Desktop/pull/2361)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Perplexity "max_tokens must be at most N" and MiniMax "does not support max tokens > N" 400s end the turn instead of clamping the output ceiling
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agent-runtime): read Perplexity and MiniMax max_tokens ceilings. Target files: packages/agent-runtime/src/provider-retry.test.ts, packages/agent-runtime/src/provider-retry.ts. `outputTokenCeiling` now reads Perplexity's `max_tokens must be at most N` wording (backticks optional; also `max_completion_tokens` / `max_output_tokens`) and MiniMax's `does not support max tokens > N`. A 400 of either shape takes the existing one-shot clamp repair instead of ending the turn. (Ref: https://github.com/vastsa/PI-Desktop/pull/2363)
